verdict.rationale: Exa has a dedicated rate-limits docs page stating that API endpoints have default rate limits ([exa-docs-16]), and a public pricing page with self-serve sign-up credits that need no payment method ([exa-docs-34]). The evidence does not show the actual limit numbers, any concurrency caps, or how to upgrade or raise limits without contacting sales. Missing for 10: specific per-endpoint rate-limit and concurrency values, a documented self-serve path to raise limits or upgrade tiers, independent corroboration.
